def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    if not customers:
        return []
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    nn = instance.get("nearest_neighbors", {})
    desc = instance.get("descriptors", {}) or {}
    vehicle_hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", 0) or 0

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    def route_load(r):
        s = 0
        for c in r:
            s += demands[c]
        return s

    def route_cost(r):
        if not r:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][r[0]] + matrix[r[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(r) - 1):
            c += matrix[r[i]][r[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        s = 0
        for r in routes:
            s += route_cost(r)
        return s

    def two_opt(route):
        # deterministic first-improvement 2-opt
        m = len(route)
        if m < 4:
            return route
        best = route_cost(route)
        improved = True
        # limit work: scan with increasing i,j but stop after first improvement per pass
        while improved:
            improved = False
            for i in range(m - 3):
                a = route[i]
                b = route[i + 1]
                for j in range(i + 2, m - 1):
                    c = route[j]
                    d = route[j + 1]
                    delta = (matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]) - (matrix[a][b] + matrix[c][d])
                    if delta < 0:
                        # apply reversal i+1..j
                        newr = route[:i + 1] + route[i + 1:j + 1][::-1] + route[j + 1:]
                        route = newr
                        best += delta
                        improved = True
                        m = len(route)
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
        return route

    def best_insert_pos_cost(route, node, pos):
        # cost if insert node into route at index pos (0..len)
        # compute delta locally
        if not route:
            return matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][depot]
        if pos <= 0:
            # depot->node->route0
            return matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][route[0]] + sum(matrix[route[k]][route[k + 1]] for k in range(len(route) - 1)) + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
